# Architecture

This is a single Frappe app (`healthcare`) installed on a bench next to `frappe` and `erpnext`.

## Layout
- `healthcare/hooks.py`: the app wiring. It sets `doc_events` (on core and ERPNext DocTypes such as Sales Invoice, Payment Entry and Company, plus a `*` wildcard that creates Patient Medical Records), `scheduler_events` (appointment reminders, daily status updates), `override_doctype_class` (Sales Invoice → `HealthcareSalesInvoice`), `doctype_js`, Jinja methods, `on_login`, and `before_tests`.
- `healthcare/healthcare/` is the module (`modules.txt` → `Healthcare`):
  - `doctype/<snake_name>/`: about 138 DocTypes. Each folder holds `<name>.json` (schema), `<name>.py` (controller class), `<name>.js` (form script), an optional `<name>_list.js`, and `test_<name>.py`.
  - `custom_doctype/`: overrides and hooks for ERPNext docs (`sales_invoice.py`, `payment_entry.py`).
  - `api/patient_portal.py`: whitelisted endpoints that the Vue portal calls.
  - `utils.py`: a large shared module (≈1.9k lines) covering billing, invoice hooks and test bootstrap.
  - `report/`, `dashboard_chart(_source)/`, `number_card/`, `workspace/`, `print_format/`, `web_form/`, `page/`, `onboarding_step/`, `setup/`.
- `healthcare/controllers/`: shared base classes, for example `ServiceRequestController(Document)`, which Service Request and Medication Request use.
- `healthcare/regional/india/abdm/`: country-specific integration, hooked from `doc_events["Patient"]`.
- `healthcare/patches/v0_0|v15_0|v16_0/`: data migrations, registered in `healthcare/patches.txt` (pre-sync and `[post_model_sync]` sections).
- `healthcare/www/`: website routes. `patient_portal.py/.html` serves the built SPA.
- `healthcare/public/`: desk JS bundle, images, and built portal assets.
- `patient_portal/`: Vue source. Vite builds it into `healthcare/public/...` and rewrites `healthcare/www/patient_portal.html`.
- `healthcare/workspace_sidebar/`, `healthcare/desktop_icon/`: desk navigation JSON.
- `wiki/`: design notes and usage docs.
- `.build/`: Interactor Build project metadata.

## Call flow
- Desk UI → form JS → `frappe.call` to `@frappe.whitelist()` methods in DocType controllers or `utils.py`.
- Portal SPA → `frappe-ui` `frappeRequest` → `healthcare.healthcare.api.patient_portal.*`.
- ERPNext documents → `doc_events` hooks → healthcare utils (billing, insurance claims, fee validity).
- Cross-module imports always use absolute dotted paths (`healthcare.healthcare.doctype.x.x`).
